import json, re, time, os, collections
# relayout measured start ~ launch + sequential warmups (sum of warmup walls)
launch = time.mktime(time.strptime("2026-09-26 17:35:08", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"))
warm = sum(float(m) for m in re.findall(r"warmup \d+ rc=0 wall=([0-9.]+)s", open("mix4x4h10_relayout.out").read()))
rel_start = launch + 5 + warm
elapsed = time.time() - rel_start
print(f"relayout warmup {warm:.0f} s, measured elapsed {elapsed:.0f} s")
rel = collections.Counter(m for m in re.findall(r"^\[(\w+)\] measured \d+ rc=0", open("mix4x4h10_relayout.out").read(), re.M))
rel_wall = collections.defaultdict(list)
for p, w in re.findall(r"^\[(\w+)\] measured \d+ rc=0 wall=([0-9.]+)s", open("mix4x4h10_relayout.out").read(), re.M):
    rel_wall[p].append(float(w))
s = json.load(open("mix4x4h10_ours/summary.json")); start = s["start"]
recs = [json.loads(l) for l in open("mix4x4h10_ours/sessions.jsonl")]
recs = [r for r in recs if r["phase"] == "measured"]
print(f"{'program':13} {'ours done@same elapsed':>22} {'relayout done':>14} {'ours mean wall (those)':>22} {'relayout mean wall':>19}")
for p in ["BFCL_agent", "coding_agent", "doc_analysis", "fact_check"]:
    od = [r["wall"] for r in recs if r["program"] == p and r["t1"] - start <= elapsed]
    rw = rel_wall[p]
    print(f"{p:13} {len(od):22} {rel[p]:14} {sum(od)/len(od):22.1f} {sum(rw)/len(rw):19.1f}")
print("total", sum(1 for r in recs if r["t1"] - start <= elapsed), sum(rel.values()))
EOF
